description: This Java class defines a data transfer object (DTO) called LoanCollateralResponseData used within the Fineract project. It encapsulates information related to loan collateral management, providing methods for instantiation from domain objects and conversion to command objects. The class leverages Lombok annotations to generate boilerplate code.

classes.name: LoanCollateralResponseData
classes.description: A data transfer object representing response data for loan collateral, including methods for creating instances from domain objects and converting to command objects.

methods.name: instanceOf
methods.description: Creates a new LoanCollateralResponseData instance from a LoanCollateralManagement domain object, including total and totalCollateral values.

methods.name: toCommand
methods.description: Converts the response data object into a LoanCollateralManagementData command object for further processing or persistence.
